summary: While the Sign Up button was intentionally centered, the Username and Password form labels were also unintentionally centered, leaving them misaligned with their left-aligned input fields.

regressions.explanation: The 'Username' label shifted from its original left-aligned position (box 1) to the center of the form card, misaligning it with the left-aligned input box and placeholder text below it.
regressions.violated_rule: Design intent specifies only that the "Sign Up" button in the free trial form was centered, not the form labels.

regressions.explanation: The 'Password' label shifted from its original left-aligned position (box 3) to the center of the form card, misaligning it with the left-aligned password input field below it.
regressions.violated_rule: Design intent specifies only that the "Sign Up" button in the free trial form was centered, not the form labels.
